control.commit_implementation: At every simulated commit, append actual YUV frame and exact PCM chunk bytes to exclusive raw spools, fsync, and extend an immutable hash-chain ledger. Later packets may update public delay history but cannot replace existing spool bytes.
control.feedback_rule: timeout=min(240,max(base_ms,max(last-eight observed delays in either modality)+margin_ms)); choose wait only while a required packet is absent and now is before the resulting source-release deadline
control.fit: Select one of nine feedback parameter pairs only on 10 fit speakers and their four registered scenarios, minimizing terminal entropic loss; exact ties break by base then margin. Select the fixed comparison baseline among 80/240 ms on the same fit census before calibration.
control.fit_media_scope: Finite transport search uses actual source packet reference hashes and full packet inclusion/loss census, without serializing non-selected candidates. Every candidate simulation and measured fitting cost is retained. Codec/content equivalence must subsequently pass the independent calibration gate.
control.late_after_commit: May update observed-delay history but cannot replace already committed black/silent content
control.missing_audio: zero PCM over exactly the original source samples of that slot
control.missing_video: Y plane16, U/V128 at the original slot

episode_seed: big-endian first 8 SHA256 bytes of UTF8(hepta-causal-av-stream-v1|{source_id}|{scenario}) modulo 2^63; independent of policy

evaluation.benefit_gate: paired 95% bootstrap lower bound of NDU improvement >0 AND lower bound of joint completion difference >=-0.02
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: Resample 16 speakers with replacement; carry all four network scenarios and all three policies together
evaluation.execution_order: Sort policy names within each source/scenario by SHA256(hepta-causal-av-order-v1|source_id|scenario|policy), keeping common network events
evaluation.no_extra_units: Different network scenarios, source frames, proof cases and policies are repeated measures, not independent speakers
evaluation.primary_contrast: learned feedback NDU minus fit-selected fixed baseline NDU
report: both modal completion and joint completion
actual policy/simulator/service wall and CPU P50/P95
reference setup, fitting, qualification and complete subprocess costs
evaluation.unexecuted_or_failed_cases: Retain their registered cells with failure loss1 and explicit error; scientific/engineering benefit claim cannot pass an incomplete census

network.draw_order: choose skew/burst modality from [video,audio]; choose burst_start via randrange(8,58); then index 0..74, channel [video,audio], draw choice([0,20,40]) jitter_ms, random() drop draw, random() late draw for every packet

families.burst: drawn modality additionally +40ms for six packets starting at burst_start
families.name: modality_arrival_skew

families.burst: drawn modality drops three packets starting at burst_start
families.name: loss_and_loss_burst

families.burst: drawn modality additionally receives the same +160ms late flag for six packets starting at burst_start; not additive when late draw is already true
families.name: late_observation_and_burst

network.no_unknown_clock_origin_task: Source media PTS remain correct; perturbation changes transport arrivals, not the declared source timestamp origin
public_to_policy: current source slot and source release timestamp
availability of currently arrived video/audio packets
last eight observed packet delays in each modality
network.rng: Python 3.12 random.Random with the registered scenario seed

open_beyond_this_subexperiment: Shared semantic correction with delayed benefits in several generated modalities

pre_execution_revision.reason: Separate packet delivery coverage, byte fidelity, effective alignment coverage and simulated timestamps before any fit/cal run

additional_tests: Already-committed source slot rewrite is rejected and raw prefix unchanged
All slots and the short final PCM packet survive serialization without tail truncation
Natural silent/black source packets count as delivered if committed; identical placeholders do not count as delivery
Policy action prefix is invariant to modifications confined to not-yet-arrived events
qualification.census_gate: Every output retains all 75 video slots and exactly 131328 stereo samples; all five sources and all seven conditions must be reported
qualification.clock_observer_gate: Every signed known relative clock perturbation recovered to at most 0.001 seconds absolute error; no source or condition selection
qualification.lossless_content_gate: Every decoded output plane and PCM sample must equal the actual intended source-or-placeholder input bytes in all 35 cases
qualification.missing_content_gate: Actual committed packet IDs and packet/sample counts determine coverage. All declared missing IDs remain absent even when their black/silent placeholder equals natural source content; byte fidelity is checked separately.
qualification.qualification_meaning: Deterministic source/reference and container-clock observer qualification only; no independent AVSync/lip semantic qualification

representation.video: Original decoded 360x288 yuv420p planes, unchanged except explicit black missing-packet placeholders
representation.video_frame_pts_ms: 0,40,...,2960 from actual source PTS, not nominal 50/1 fps

scope: Real recorded AV media with a simulated network and virtual delivery clock; correct source media timestamps are public headers; no live-network, physiological AV-offset, independent lip-sync or generated-content inference

serialization.readback: Decode every output again to actual video planes and PCM; retain per-frame and per-audio-packet SHA256, actual stream/frame PTS, original-reference hashes and every subprocess receipt
serialization.storage_gate: First encode one fixed fit source as a codec-only pilot, retain its exact bytes and costs, and report projected 35 qualification and 192 evaluation output sizes. Current phase must remain <=1GB and >=2GB free; any larger future evaluation allocation requires root release before outcomes, never fewer cases or discarded evidence.
serialization.temporary_raw_inputs: Owned temporary raw copies removed after final output/readback receipts; source originals and final AV outputs always retained
serialization.timeline_relation: MKV media PTS preserve the source media clock (plus a known qualification-only clock perturbation). Virtual packet commit/delivery times exist separately in the ledger and are not added to media PTS. This is offline real-media serialization under simulated transport, not a physical real-time playback measurement.

utility.NDU: -log(mean(exp(4*loss)))/4 with equal weights on all registered speaker/scenario cells
utility.actual_service_cost: Policy, simulator, serialization, fsync, decoding/readback, source setup and total process wall/CPU are separately retained. Simulated delivery latency is not added to wall time and is not called measured physical playout latency.
utility.clock_error: Report signed and absolute container-clock relation only on jointly delivered video/audio slots, alongside valid alignment coverage. No valid slots means conditional error is null and clock penalty is1. Correct paired source PTS make zero valid error structural; it is not a content or lip-sync improvement.
utility.content_fidelity: Every output must decode byte-exactly to its appended source-or-placeholder bytes. Report fidelity separately from delivery coverage; a failure retains case loss1 and blocks complete engineering qualification.
utility.joint_completion: q_video*q_audio, where q_video is source-video packet delivery coverage and q_audio is delivered original-audio sample coverage, from actual append-only commit records. Fidelity of encoded/decoded bytes is separate. Never infer missing packets from black pixels or silence.
